tools.name: search_students
tools.description: The student directory: find students by name, admission number or class, or list the students the caller may see when no search is given. Use this first whenever the user names a student but you do not have their id. Returns each match with class, roll number, student id and enrolment id. Read-only.

query.description: Name, admission number or class, e.g. "Rahul", "OAK-12", "Class 6 A". Omit to list everyone in scope.

limit.description: Only when the user asks for a number ("top 10", "first 5"); omit it to return everything

tools.name: get_student
tools.description: One student's record: name, admission number, class, roll number and enrolment status. Identify the student by id, admission number or name. Reading this is recorded as a personal-data access. Read-only.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: get_student_overview
tools.description: Several facets of one student in one call. Choose only what the question needs with `include`: profile (class, roll number, class teacher's name), personal (date of birth, gender, address), guardians (names, relation, contact numbers), attendance (this month), performance (published results), assignments (submission status), medical (only returned if the caller may read medical records). Defaults to profile, attendance and performance. For a single fact prefer the narrower tool. Read-only.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

include.description: Any of: profile, personal, guardians, attendance, performance, assignments, medical. Default: profile, attendance, performance

tools.service: student.service.getOverview() — narrowed to the requested sections

tools.name: list_guardians
tools.description: The guardians linked to a student — name, relation and whether they are the primary contact. Read-only.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: add_guardian
tools.description: Link an existing parent profile to a student as their father, mother or guardian. Once linked, that parent can see the child's attendance, marks and fees, so this always needs confirmation. The guardian's profile id comes from list_users.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

guardianProfileId.description: The parent's profile id, e.g. from list_users

guardianName.description: The parent's name as a person writes it, e.g. "Mr Sharma". An existing parent profile; alternative to guardianProfileId.

isPrimary.description: Whether this is the primary contact

pickupAuthorized.description: Whether they may collect the child; defaults to yes

tools.name: list_enrollments
tools.description: Enrolment rows — student, class, roll number and enrolment status — optionally narrowed to one class, one student, or one academic year. Read-only.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

tools.name: create_student
tools.description: Create a new student record. Requires an admission number and first name. This creates ERP data and needs confirmation before it happens. It does NOT enrol the student in a class — use enroll_student afterwards.

tools.name: enroll_student
tools.description: Enrol an existing student into a section for an academic year, optionally with a roll number. Changes ERP data; needs confirmation.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

academicYear.description: The year as a person names it, e.g. "2026-27". Omit for the current year.

tools.name: update_student
tools.description: Correct a student's personal details. Only first name, last name, date of birth, gender and address may be changed here — admission number, class, roll number and enrolment status are the school's own record and are refused. Changes ERP data; needs confirmation.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

fields.description: The values to change. Only firstName, lastName, dob, gender and address are accepted.

tools.service: student.service.update() — behind an MCP field allow-list

tools.name: update_enrollment_status
tools.description: Change an enrolment's status to ACTIVE, TRANSFERRED, WITHDRAWN or GRADUATED. This is the school's formal record of whether a student is on roll. Changes ERP data; needs confirmation.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: archive_student
tools.description: Deactivate a student record and withdraw their active enrolments. This is a soft delete — the record is retained and can be reviewed afterwards. It does NOT erase personal data; use anonymise_student for that. Always needs confirmation.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: anonymise_student
tools.description: IRREVERSIBLE. Permanently erase a student's personal data (name, date of birth, gender, address, photo) while keeping the anonymous academic record. Use only for a data-erasure request. Cannot be undone. Always needs confirmation.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

reason.description: Why erasure was requested — recorded in the audit trail

tools.name: get_student_attendance
tools.description: Use only when the user asks about the attendance of one specific named student: days present, working days and the percentage. Name a student to look up theirs; name nobody and it answers for the caller (or their child). Do not use for cohort queries, percentage-threshold queries, or "which students" questions (use get_at_risk_students instead). Read-only.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: get_absent_students
tools.description: Today's absence snapshot for the whole school: how many students are absent, present, late and excused, and whether the register has been marked at all. Use for "who is absent today" and "how many are absent". Read-only.

tools.name: get_attendance_roster
tools.description: Attendance for one whole class, for one date or one calendar month: on a date, every enrolled student with the status marked for them and who is absent; for a month, the class summary. This is the class-level answer — use it for "show the attendance of Class 5-A" and "who is absent in Class 5-A today". There is no class figure over a longer range. Name the class with className; sectionId is for when an id is already known. Read-only.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

sectionId.description: The class section, when the id is already known

month.description: YYYY-MM — the class summary for a whole month

tools.name: get_attendance_trend
tools.description: Month-by-month attendance percentages for a student, for spotting a decline over time. Read-only.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: get_subject_attendance
tools.description: A student's attendance broken down per subject. Note the `basis` field: DAY means the day's status was attributed to each subject scheduled that weekday, PERIOD means true per-period marks. Read-only.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: get_attendance_calendar
tools.description: A day-by-day attendance calendar for one student for one month, showing the status recorded on each date. Read-only.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

month.description: YYYY-MM; defaults to the current month

tools.name: get_lecture_attendance
tools.description: Lecture-by-lecture attendance for one student over a month or a date range: each period with its subject, time and the status recorded. Only periods actually marked per lecture are counted — a whole-day mark says nothing about an individual lecture. Read-only.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: get_attendance_statistics
tools.description: Attendance statistics. For staff, the school's register for a date with the present percentage; for a student or parent, their own summary. Read-only.

tools.name: get_class_attendance_summary
tools.description: Attendance compared ACROSS classes over a period, plus the figure for all of them together: each class with its attendance percentage, ranked. Use for "which class has the lowest/highest attendance", "class-wise attendance", "rank classes by attendance" and "overall attendance" of the school. The period is one date, one month, or a from/to range; with none it is the current month to date, and the answer always states the period. A school-wide reader sees every class; a teacher sees only the classes they teach. For ONE class use get_attendance_roster, for one student get_student_attendance. Read-only.

order.description: Rank from the lowest or the highest attendance; lowest first by default

limit.description: Only when the user asks for a number of classes ("bottom 3")

tools.name: who_is_absent_today
tools.description: Today's school-wide absence snapshot for leadership. Equivalent to get_absent_students. Read-only.

tools.name: get_attendance
tools.description: The caller's own attendance summary — or, for staff, today's school register. Use get_student_attendance instead when the user names a particular student. Read-only.

tools.name: mark_attendance
tools.description: Record attendance on a date. Say who in one of two ways: `students` — name them (by name, admission number or id) each with a status, which is how "mark Rahul absent" works; or `sectionId` plus `entries` of enrolment ids, as returned by get_attendance_roster. Everyone in one call must be in the same class. This writes to the attendance register — the record a family may dispute later — so it always needs confirmation and is fully audited. Re-marking the same student and date updates the existing entry rather than adding a second one.

students.description: Students named directly, each with the status to record

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

everyone.description: Mark every pupil on the named class register with this status; pupils named in `students` are the exceptions

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

sectionId.description: The class section, when giving entries

entries.description: One entry per enrolment, when marking a register from get_attendance_roster

tools.name: bulk_mark_attendance
tools.description: Mark a whole section at once from a list of rows, typically "everyone present except these". Bulk register changes always need confirmation. Use mark_attendance for a handful of named students.

rows.description: One row per student, named by roll number or admission number within the section. (To mark by enrolment id, use mark_attendance with entries.)

tools.name: get_pending_fees
tools.description: Unpaid and partly paid fee invoices with the amount still owed on each, and the outstanding total. Use for "who has pending fees", "how much is outstanding", and "what are Rahul's fees" (pass search). With a search or section the totals cover only what matched; without one they cover everything the caller may see. Staff see the school; a family sees their own. Read-only.

search.description: One student by name or admission number, or an invoice number

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

limit.description: Invoices to return, only when the user asks for a number; omit for all

tools.name: get_fee_statistics
tools.description: Fee collection statistics: total billed, total collected, collection percentage, and what is outstanding and overdue. Use for "how much have we collected" and collection-rate questions. Read-only.

tools.name: get_payment_history
tools.description: Fee payments that have been recorded — receipt number, invoice, student, amount, mode, date and verification status. Also the answer to fee collection over a period: how much was collected this month, today or between two dates. Staff see the school; a family sees only their own settled payments. Read-only.

search.description: Student name, admission number or receipt/invoice number

limit.description: Only when the user asks for a number ("top 10", "first 5"); omit it to return everything

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: One fee invoice in full — line items, total, amount paid, status, due date and the payments settled against it. Name it by invoiceId or by its invoice number. Read-only.

tools.name: get_fee_plans
tools.description: Installment and part-payment plans, with the approval stage each is at. Use for "which installment plans are waiting for approval". Read-only.

tools.name: get_payment_change_requests
tools.description: Requests to amend a finalised payment record, with what was asked for and the current decision. Read-only.

tools.name: get_fee_structures
tools.description: The fee heads and fee structures configured for the school, by academic year and grade. Read-only.

tools.name: get_fees
tools.description: The caller's own outstanding fee balance and payment status. Use get_pending_fees instead when the user asks about students in general or names one. Read-only.

tools.name: get_payment_link
tools.description: A link the caller can use to pay their own outstanding invoice online. Returns links only — it never moves money. Read-only.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Raise one fee invoice against one enrolment, with its line items. The invoice number must be unique; a duplicate is refused. Creates a financial record, so it always needs confirmation. To bill a whole year or grade from the fee structures, use generate_invoices.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

invoiceNo.description: The new invoice number, unique in the school

description.description: What this line charges for, e.g. "Tuition — Term 1"

concessionPaise.description: Discount on this line, in paise

tools.name: generate_invoices
tools.description: Generate invoices in bulk for every active enrolment in an academic year (optionally one grade) from the configured fee structures. Enrolments already billed for a structure are skipped, so running it twice does not bill anyone twice. This bills many families at once, so it needs confirmation — run it with dryRun: true first to see how many invoices it would create, which needs none.

academicYear.description: The year as a person names it, e.g. "2026-27". Omit for the current year; the confirmation names it.

gradeId.description: Restrict to one grade; omit to bill the whole year

grade.description: Restrict to one grade by name, e.g. "Class 6"

dryRun.description: Count and total without writing anything

tools.name: create_fee_plan
tools.description: Draft an installment or part-payment plan for one enrolment. This creates a DRAFT only — it approves and publishes nothing; those are separate, separately-permissioned steps (transition_fee_plan, publish_fee_plan). Installment amounts must add up exactly to totalPaise. Needs confirmation.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

installments.description: Installments in due-date order. Their amounts must add up exactly to totalPaise. ONE_TIME has exactly one; PARTIAL and INSTALLMENT at least two.

feeHeadId.description: The fee head this plan settles, if one

tools.name: update_fee_plan
tools.description: Amend a fee plan that is still a draft or came back rejected. A plan under review, approved or published cannot be edited — the service refuses. Needs confirmation.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

installments.description: Installments in due-date order. Their amounts must add up exactly to totalPaise. ONE_TIME has exactly one; PARTIAL and INSTALLMENT at least two.

tools.name: update_payment
tools.description: Correct a payment record: its mode, paid-on date, receipt number, notes or instrument details. The amount can only be changed on a rejected payment. Every field changed is individually audited by the fee service, and changing a verified payment needs payment-approval rights. Give a reason. Always needs confirmation.

invoiceNo.description: The invoice the payment is on, e.g. "INV-1042". Alternative to paymentId.

instrument.description: Required for CHEQUE, DD and BANK: number, bankName, instrumentDate and a proofUrl (image or PDF). Not used for CASH.

number.description: Cheque, DD or transfer reference number

instrumentDate.description: Date on the cheque, DD or transfer

reason.description: Why the record is being corrected — recorded with the change

tools.name: request_payment_change
tools.description: Ask for a correction to a published (finalised) payment — one field, its new value and why. Nothing changes until someone with payment-approval rights approves it. Editable fields: amountPaise, mode, paidOn, receiptNo, notes and the instrument details. A payment still awaiting approval is corrected with update_payment instead. Needs confirmation.

invoiceNo.description: The invoice the payment is on, e.g. "INV-1042". Alternative to paymentId.

requestedValue.description: The new value; paise for amountPaise, YYYY-MM-DD for dates

tools.name: transition_fee_plan
tools.description: Send a fee plan on along its workflow: submit (draft → finance review) or requestApproval (finance-reviewed → admin approval). Reviewing, approving, rejecting and publishing a plan are decisions a person makes on the fee plan screen, never through the assistant. Each step needs its own permission. Needs confirmation.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: create_fee_head
tools.description: Add a fee head — the thing a charge is for, such as "Tuition" or "Transport". A fee head is school-wide configuration and every future structure and invoice is billed against it, so it needs confirmation. The name must be one the school does not already use.

tools.name: create_fee_structure
tools.description: Set what a fee head costs for an academic year, and optionally for one grade only — omit the grade and it applies to every grade. This is what invoices are generated from, so it decides what families are billed and always needs confirmation. Use get_fee_structures for the existing configuration and the fee head id.

feeHead.description: The fee head by name, e.g. "Tuition". Omit when the structure name starts with an existing fee head. Alternative to feeHeadId.

academicYearId.description: The year this charge applies to

academicYear.description: The year as a person names it, e.g. "2026-27". Omit for the current year; the confirmation names it.

gradeId.description: One grade only; omit for every grade

grade.description: One grade by name, e.g. "Class 6". Omit for every grade.

amountPaise.description: The amount in paise, so ₹4,000 is 400000

tools.name: list_classes
tools.description: The school's grades and class sections, with each section's id and class teacher. Use this to turn a class name like "Class 6 A" into the sectionId other tools need. Read-only.

tools.name: list_subjects
tools.description: Every subject configured for the school, and the subject offerings that link a subject to a section and a teacher. Read-only.

tools.name: list_academic_years
tools.description: Academic years and terms, with which year is current. Use this to get the academicYearId other tools require. Read-only.

tools.name: get_my_classes
tools.description: The caller's own sections and subject offerings — for a teacher, the classes they teach. Can be narrowed to one of those classes. Read-only.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

sectionId.description: One of the caller's own sections

tools.name: create_section
tools.description: Create a class section within a grade, optionally assigning a class teacher. Needs confirmation.

grade.description: The grade as a person names it, e.g. "Class 7". Alternative to gradeId.

classTeacher.description: The class teacher as a person names them. Alternative to classTeacherId.

tools.name: create_academic_year
tools.description: Create an academic year, e.g. "2027-28", with its start and end dates. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: create_term
tools.description: Create a term inside an academic year, e.g. "Term 1", with its start and end dates. Name the year ("2026-27"), or leave it out for the current one. Needs confirmation.

academicYear.description: The year as a person names it, e.g. "2026-27". Omit for the current year.

tools.name: create_grade
tools.description: Create a grade (a class level such as "Class 5") with its level number, used to order grades. Sections are added to it with create_section. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: create_subject
tools.description: Add a subject to the school's subject list, e.g. "Physics", with an optional short code. Teaching it in a class is a separate step, assign_teacher_to_subject. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: update_section
tools.description: Rename a section or change its class teacher. Needs confirmation.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

name.description: A NEW name for the section

classTeacher.description: The new class teacher as a person names them. Alternative to classTeacherId.

tools.name: assign_teacher_to_subject
tools.description: Create a subject offering — the link between a subject, a section, a term and the teacher who teaches it. This is how a teacher is assigned to a class. Needs confirmation.

subject.description: The subject as a person names it, e.g. "Science". Alternative to subjectId.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

term.description: The term as a person names it, e.g. "Term 1". Omit for the running term.

teacherName.description: The teacher as a person names them. Alternative to teacherId.

tools.name: update_subject_offering
tools.description: Change a subject offering — most often to reassign the teacher. Needs confirmation.

subject.description: The subject of the offering as a person names it, e.g. "Art". Identifies the offering with className.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

term.description: The term, when the class teaches the subject in more than one

teacherName.description: The new teacher as a person names them. Alternative to teacherId.

tools.name: get_timetable
tools.description: The timetable for a day or the whole week, with the subject and the teacher for each period. Name a class to see that class alone; without one, a teacher sees the periods they teach, a student or parent their own section, and a school-wide reader the school. Accepts a weekday name, today/tomorrow/yesterday, or "week" for the weekly timetable. Read-only.

day.description: Weekday name, today/tomorrow/yesterday, or "week" for the whole week

next.description: true for "what is my next class/period?": only the next period after the current time, not the whole day

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

sectionId.description: The class section, when the id is already known

tools.name: upsert_timetable_slot
tools.description: Create or replace one timetable period for a section — its day, period number, times and subject offering. Changes what a whole class sees as its schedule, so it needs confirmation.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

day.description: The weekday by name, e.g. "Monday". Alternative to dayOfWeek.

subject.description: The subject taught in the period, e.g. "Mathematics". Omit for a break.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Published exam results and the report-card summary for the caller (or their child). Use get_report_card when the user names another student. Read-only.

tools.name: get_report_card
tools.description: A student's report card: subject marks, percentage, grade and GPA for a published exam. Only published results are visible. Read-only.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: get_class_marks
tools.description: How a whole class performed: every student's marks for the class's exam papers, with the class average, highest and lowest, and how many papers are still unmarked. Name the class, and optionally one subject or exam. This is the class-level answer — for one student's report card use get_report_card. Read-only.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

sectionId.description: The class section, when the id is already known

exam.description: Narrow to one exam, e.g. "Unit Test 2"

tools.name: get_marks_grid
tools.description: The mark-entry grid for one exam subject: every enrolled student with the marks recorded so far and the maximum. Use before enter_marks. Read-only.

tools.name: list_exams
tools.description: Exams configured for a term, and their exam subjects with maximum marks. Read-only.

examId.description: List the subjects of one exam

tools.name: get_performance_history
tools.description: A student's published results across exams over time, for spotting a trend. Read-only.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: get_performance
tools.description: A student's published marks as they stand — each graded paper with its subject and score. Distinct from get_performance_history, which reports results across years and terms to show a trend. Read-only.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: create_exam
tools.description: Create an exam within a term. Add exam subjects afterwards with create_exam_subject. Needs confirmation.

term.description: The term as a person names it, e.g. "Term 1". Omit for the running term.

tools.name: create_exam_subject
tools.description: Add a subject to an exam, with its maximum marks and exam date. Needs confirmation.

exam.description: The exam as a person names it, e.g. "Half Yearly". Alternative to examId.

subject.description: The subject of the paper, e.g. "Mathematics". With className, alternative to subjectOfferingId.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

tools.name: enter_marks
tools.description: Record, enter, submit or update marks for students in one exam paper. Name the paper by class, subject and exam, and each student by name or admission number with their marks; re-entering a student's marks updates them. Marks stay unpublished until publish_marks, so students do not see them yet, and marks already published cannot be changed. Writes to other people's academic records, so it needs confirmation.

examSubjectId.description: The exam paper, when the id is already known

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

subject.description: The subject of the paper, e.g. "Mathematics"

students.description: Students named directly, each with their marks

studentName.description: An ambiguous name is refused, never guessed

tools.name: get_assignments
tools.description: Homework and assignments. For a student or parent with no filters, the work still to be submitted, soonest deadline first. For a teacher, the work they have set — narrow it with a subject, a class, or both. Read-only.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

status.description: For a student or parent: their work still to submit (PENDING), already handed in (SUBMITTED), or both

dueFrom.description: Only work due on or after this day

dueTo.description: Only work due on or before this day

first.description: true for "which one is due first / next": only the assignment with the earliest due date that has not passed

tools.name: get_submissions
tools.description: The submissions for one assignment, with each student's status and marks where graded. Read-only.

tools.name: create_assignment
tools.description: Set an assignment or homework for a class. Identify the class and subject by name -- "Mathematics" for "Class 5-A" -- or by subjectOfferingId when you have one. Every student in that section sees it, so it needs confirmation.

subjectOfferingId.description: The class and subject it is for, when known

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

subject.description: The subject, as a person names it, e.g. "Mathematics"

title.description: What the work is -- the task, or its topic

dueAt.description: When it must be handed in

tools.name: generate_homework
tools.description: Draft homework with AI for a class you teach and set it. The draft is written before you are asked to confirm, so you approve homework that already exists in full rather than a promise to generate it. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: grade_submission
tools.description: Grade one student's assignment submission: record a mark and optional feedback. Name the student, and the assignment by its title or subject when they have submitted more than one. Needs confirmation.

assignmentId.description: The assignment, when the id is already known

enrollmentId.description: The student's enrolment, when the id is already known

title.description: The assignment title, when the subject has several

link.description: A link to the work, e.g. a Google Drive link

enrollmentId.description: Omit to use the caller's own enrolment

tools.name: get_subjects
tools.description: The subjects the caller (or their child) studies this year, with the teacher for each. Read-only.

tools.name: get_admissions
tools.description: The admissions pipeline: how many enquiries sit at each stage (new, contacted, tour scheduled, application, enrolled, lost) and who they are. Use for "how is admissions going" and "which applications are pending". Read-only.

limit.description: Leads per stage, only when the user asks for a number

tools.name: get_admission_lead
tools.description: One admission enquiry in full, with its recorded interaction history newest first. Read-only.

tools.name: create_admission_lead
tools.description: Record a new admission enquiry. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: update_admission_lead
tools.description: Move an admission enquiry along the pipeline (NEW, CONTACTED, TOUR_SCHEDULED, APPLICATION), or change its notes, assignee or next action date. Needs confirmation.

childName.description: The applicant child as a person names them, e.g. "Kabir Kapoor". Alternative to leadId.

tools.name: get_announcements
tools.description: Recent announcements addressed to the caller. The same audience filter the announcements screen uses applies, so a notice the caller was not addressed in is never read out. Read-only.

tools.name: create_announcement
tools.description: Publish or send an announcement. Name a class to address that class alone; otherwise the audience is decided by the school's own rules from the publisher's permissions — a teacher reaches the classes they teach, a school-wide publisher the school. className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

audience.description: Optional narrowing. Omit to let the school's rules decide what this publisher may address.

tools.name: update_announcement
tools.description: Correct an announcement the caller posted — its message, or its title. Identify it by id, or name the class it was sent to and say "latest"; when more than one could be meant it asks which rather than choosing. A school-wide publisher may correct any notice; anybody else only their own. Everyone who was addressed sees the change, so it always needs confirmation and nothing is written until that confirmation is accepted.

announcementId.description: When the id is already known

className.description: The class it was addressed to, e.g. "Class 5 A" or "Class 5-A"

latest.description: Take the most recent one that matches

title.description: A new title

tools.name: get_calendar_events
tools.description: School calendar events in a date range — holidays, exams, functions. Defaults to the next 30 days. Read-only.

tools.name: create_calendar_event

endsAt.description: ISO date or date-time; the same day for a one-day event

tools.name: notify_users
tools.description: Send an in-app notification to named people, by their profile ids. This appears in their EduOS notification bell — it does not send an email or a WhatsApp message. Reaches other people, so it always needs confirmation and the summary states how many recipients.

recipient.description: Who to notify, by name -- one person, or several separated by "and" or commas. Alternative to recipientProfileIds.

title.description: Defaults to the start of the message

tools.name: send_whatsapp_message
tools.description: Send one WhatsApp message to one number through the school's WhatsApp account. This leaves the school and cannot be recalled, so it always needs confirmation and the exact text is shown first. There is no bulk-send tool: the school has no approved WhatsApp broadcast capability, and Meta only permits free-form messages inside a 24-hour reply window.

to.description: Recipient number in international format, e.g. +919999900001

tools.name: get_library_summary
tools.description: Library totals: catalog size, unique titles, books currently on loan and how many are overdue. Read-only.

tools.name: get_overdue_books
tools.description: Books past their return date, with who is holding each and when it was due. Read-only.

search.description: Title, author, ISBN, category or publisher

availableOnly.description: Only items with a copy on the shelf

limit.description: Only when the user asks for a number ("top 10", "first 5"); omit it to return everything

tools.name: get_book
tools.description: One catalog item in full, with total and available copies. Name it by title or by id. Use it for "how many copies of X are available". Read-only.

title.description: The item as a person names it, e.g. "Clean Code". An ambiguous title is refused, never guessed.

tools.name: list_book_issues
tools.description: Lending records — what is on loan, to whom, when it is due, and what has been returned. A student or parent sees only their own. Read-only.

status.description: ACTIVE means currently on loan and not yet due; OVERDUE is past its return date

title.description: The item as a person names it, e.g. "Clean Code". An ambiguous title is refused, never guessed.

outstanding.description: true for everything not yet returned (on loan or overdue) — "who has this book"

limit.description: Only when the user asks for a number ("top 10", "first 5"); omit it to return everything

tools.name: create_book

tools.name: update_book

tools.name: delete_book
tools.description: Remove an item from the library catalog. It is hidden from the catalog, not erased, and its lending history is kept. It does not check for copies currently on loan, so make sure they are returned first. Always needs confirmation.

title.description: The item as a person names it, e.g. "Clean Code". An ambiguous title is refused, never guessed.

tools.name: issue_book
tools.description: Lend a library item to a student until a due date. Name the student by name, admission number or id. A copy is claimed atomically, so two simultaneous requests cannot both take the last one. Needs confirmation.

title.description: The item as a person names it, e.g. "Clean Code". An ambiguous title is refused, never guessed.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: return_book
tools.description: Record the return of a lent item. Name the item by title, and the borrower by name if more than one copy is out. Returning an item already returned is refused rather than counted twice. Needs confirmation.

title.description: The item as a person names it, e.g. "Clean Code". An ambiguous title is refused, never guessed.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: get_hostel_summary
tools.description: Hostel occupancy: beds occupied and free, occupancy rate, room count and open enquiries. Read-only.

tools.name: get_hostel_residents
tools.description: The students currently allocated a hostel bed, with room and block. Read-only.

tools.name: list_hostel_rooms
tools.description: Hostel rooms with capacity, beds occupied and beds free — use it to find a room with space. Read-only.

roomNo.description: The room as a person names it, e.g. "101"

tools.name: list_hostel_allocations
tools.description: Bed allocations — which student is in which room, active or vacated. Narrow to one room by number, or to one student by name or admission number. Read-only.

roomNo.description: The room as a person names it, e.g. "101"

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: list_hostel_inquiries
tools.description: Hostel enquiries raised by students, parents or staff, and their status. Read-only.

tools.name: create_hostel_room
tools.description: Add a hostel room with its bed capacity. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: update_hostel_room
tools.description: Change a hostel room's number, block, floor, capacity, type, status or amenities. Needs confirmation.
tools.service: hostel.service.listRooms() + updateRoom() — behind an MCP field allow-list

tools.name: create_hostel_inquiry
tools.description: Raise a hostel enquiry — a subject and optional description, optionally about one student. It is recorded as raised by the caller. It is filed in the name of the caller, so it needs confirmation.

studentId.description: The student it concerns, if any

tools.name: update_hostel_inquiry
tools.description: Move a hostel enquiry to OPEN, IN_PROGRESS or RESOLVED. Needs confirmation.

subject.description: The enquiry as its subject is written, e.g. "Fan not working". Alternative to inquiryId.

tools.name: allocate_hostel_bed
tools.description: Allocate a bed in a hostel room to a student, named by name, admission number or id. A student who already holds an active allocation is refused rather than given a second bed. Needs confirmation.

roomNo.description: The room as a person names it, e.g. "101"

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.description: Vacate a hostel allocation, freeing the bed. An allocation already vacated is refused. Needs confirmation.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: get_my_bus
tools.description: The caller's own (or their child's) bus assignment: route, vehicle, driver and pickup stop. Use for "which bus am I on" and "what is my pickup point". Read-only.

tools.name: get_transport_roster
tools.description: Which students travel on which route, optionally for one section. Read-only.

tools.name: list_transport_routes
tools.description: Active bus routes with vehicle, driver, number of stops and number of students enrolled. Read-only.

tools.name: list_transport_stops
tools.description: One route's stops, in the order the bus reaches them. Read-only.

tools.name: create_transport_route
tools.description: Create a bus route with its vehicle and driver. Add stops afterwards with create_transport_stop. Needs confirmation.

fareAmountPaise.description: What a place on this route costs for the year, in paise, so ₹12,000 is 1200000. Omit for a route that carries no charge.

tools.name: update_transport_route
tools.description: Correct a bus route — its vehicle, its driver, whether it is running, or what a place on it costs for the year. Changing the fare does not re-bill anyone: each approved request was invoiced at the fare it was granted at, so this decides what the next approval costs. Use list_transport_routes to find the route id. Needs confirmation.

routeName.description: The route as it is written, e.g. "Route 2". An ambiguous name is refused, never guessed.

name.description: A NEW name for the route

fareAmountPaise.description: The yearly fare in paise, so ₹12,000 is 1200000. Zero means the route carries no charge.

tools.name: create_transport_stop
tools.description: Add a stop to a bus route at a position in its order. Two stops cannot share a position on one route. Needs confirmation.

routeName.description: The route as it is written, e.g. "Route 7". Alternative to routeId.

tools.name: enroll_in_transport
tools.description: Put a student on a bus route and stop for an academic year (the current one if not given). A student has one enrolment per year, so enrolling again moves them. Needs confirmation.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

routeName.description: The route as it is written, e.g. "Route 7". Alternative to routeId.

stopId.description: A stop on that route, from list_transport_stops

stopName.description: The stop as it is written, e.g. "Market". Alternative to stopId.

tools.name: get_leave_requests
tools.description: Leave applications. For someone who reviews leave, the ones waiting on them (default status PENDING); for anyone else, their own. Use for "which leave requests are pending". Read-only.

mine.description: The caller's own applications, even if they can review

from.description: Only leave overlapping this date or later

to.description: Only leave overlapping this date or earlier

tools.name: apply_for_leave
tools.description: Submit a leave application for the caller, with a start date, end date and reason. Needs confirmation, so the dates and reason are approved before the application is filed.

tools.name: get_registration_reviews
tools.description: Elective subject registrations waiting for a decision, with the student and subject each asked for. Read-only.

from.description: Only requests made on this date or later

to.description: Only requests made on this date or earlier

tools.name: get_my_electives
tools.description: The elective subjects open to the caller and the ones they have already registered for. Read-only.

tools.name: register_for_elective
tools.description: Register the caller for an elective subject open to their class, named as a person names it, e.g. "Music". It goes for review before it takes effect. Needs confirmation.

subjectOfferingId.description: From get_my_electives. Omit it and name the subject instead.

subject.description: The elective as a person names it, e.g. "Music"

tools.name: withdraw_elective_registration
tools.description: Withdraw the caller's own elective registration. Name the elective by its subject; with only one registration, no name is needed. Needs confirmation.

subject.description: The elective as a person names it, e.g. "Music"

tools.name: get_student_requests
tools.description: Student-raised requests waiting for a decision: co-curricular achievements to add to a profile, and profile-correction requests. Profile corrections are included only for callers who may review them. Read-only.

tools.name: list_cocurricular
tools.description: Co-curricular activities and achievements on a student's record, in every state — approved, pending and rejected. Distinct from the review queue: this is what the record holds, not what is waiting for a decision. Read-only.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: request_cocurricular
tools.description: Ask for a co-curricular activity or achievement to be added to the caller's own profile. The activity date cannot be in the future. It goes to the class teacher for review and changes nothing until approved. It files a request in the name of the caller, so it needs confirmation.

tools.name: get_editable_fields
tools.description: The profile fields a student may request a correction to. Read-only.

tools.name: request_profile_edit
tools.description: Ask for a correction to the caller's own profile. Only first name, last name, date of birth, gender and address can be corrected this way. Only one request may be pending at a time. Changes nothing until a class teacher approves. It files a request in the name of the caller, so it needs confirmation.

field.description: The field to correct, as a person names it, e.g. "address" or "date of birth"

tools.name: get_medical_record
tools.description: A student's medical record: blood group, height, weight, allergies, medications, history and emergency contact. Sensitive — the service limits it to the student's class teacher, medical staff and family, and every read is audited. Read-only.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: upsert_medical_record
tools.description: Create or update a student's medical record. Only the fields given are changed. This is sensitive health data a school may act on in an emergency, so it always needs confirmation and is audited.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: remove_medical_record
tools.description: Delete a student's medical record. The school may need it in an emergency, so this always needs confirmation.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: list_tickets
tools.description: Support tickets — the caller's own, or the ones routed to them. Read-only.

from.description: Only tickets raised on this date or later

to.description: Only tickets raised on this date or earlier

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description: One support ticket with its full reply thread. Read-only.

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description: Raise a support ticket with a subject, routed to the admin office, warden, librarian or — for a question about a child — the class teacher. studentId.description: Required when routing to the class teacher

tools.name: reply_to_ticket
tools.description: Post a reply on a support ticket. The other party sees it, so it needs confirmation.

subject.description: The ticket as a person names it, e.g. "ID card". An ambiguous subject is refused, never guessed.

tools.name: update_ticket
tools.description: Change a ticket's status, priority or assignee. Only those three fields can be changed here. Needs confirmation.

subject.description: The ticket as a person names it, e.g. "ID card". An ambiguous subject is refused, never guessed.

tools.service: ticket.service.list() + update() — behind an MCP field allow-list

tools.name: request_book
tools.description: Ask the library to issue a book to the caller. Name it by title or by id. The book must be a physical copy in this school's catalogue — an online resource is read where it lives and cannot be issued. The request goes to the librarian and changes nothing until it is approved. It files a request in the name of the caller, so it needs confirmation.

title.description: The book as a person names it, e.g. "Introduction to Algorithms". An ambiguous title is refused, never guessed.

tools.name: get_my_book_requests
tools.description: The caller's own book requests and what was decided on each. Read-only.

tools.name: get_book_requests
tools.description: Book requests waiting for the librarian to decide, with who asked and whether a copy is free. Defaults to the pending ones. Read-only.

limit.description: Only when the user asks for a number ("top 10", "first 5"); omit it to return everything

tools.name: get_transport_routes
tools.description: The bus routes the caller can ask for, with each route's stops and what a place on it costs for the year. Also says whether the caller already has a request or a place. Read-only.

tools.name: request_transport_route
tools.description: Ask for a place on a bus route, from a particular stop. Name the route the way it is written ("Route 2") and, where the route has more than one stop, name the stop too. The stop must be one on that route. The request goes to the school office and changes nothing until it is approved — the fare is only charged once a place is granted. routeName.description: The route as it is written, e.g. "Route 2"

stopName.description: The stop as it is written

tools.name: get_my_transport_requests
tools.description: The caller's own transport requests and what was decided on each. Read-only.

tools.name: get_transport_requests
tools.description: Transport requests waiting for a decision, with who asked, which route and stop, and the fare. Defaults to the pending ones. Read-only.

limit.description: Only when the user asks for a number ("top 10", "first 5"); omit it to return everything

title.description: The book the request is for, e.g. "Clean Code"

tools.description: Withdraw the caller's own request for a place on a bus route, while the school office has not yet decided on it. A request already granted or refused cannot be withdrawn. requestId.description: From get_my_transport_requests. Omit it when you have only one pending request.

routeName.description: The route the request is for, e.g. "Route 2"

tools.name: cancel_cocurricular_request
tools.description: Withdraw the caller's own co-curricular request, while the class teacher has not yet decided on it. A request already approved or rejected cannot be withdrawn. requestId.description: From list_cocurricular. Omit it when you have only one pending request.

tools.name: cancel_profile_edit_request
tools.description: Withdraw the caller's own profile-correction request, while it has not yet been decided. A request already approved or rejected cannot be withdrawn. With no request id, the caller's single pending request is withdrawn; with several pending, the caller is asked which. Needs confirmation.

requestId.description: From get_my_profile_edit_requests. Omit it when you have only one pending request.

field.description: The field the correction is to, e.g. "address"

tools.name: get_my_profile_edit_requests
tools.description: The caller's own profile-correction requests and what was decided on each. A parent sees their children's. Read-only.

tools.name: get_at_risk_students
tools.description: Students flagged at risk from the last 30 days of attendance, published marks and overdue fees. Use for school-wide or class-wide queries asking which students are below an attendance percentage threshold, such as "which students are below 75% attendance" (pass attendanceBelowPct: 75) — it returns each student whose day-level attendance over the last 30 days is below that figure, with the percentage. tools.name: get_growth_score

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

period.description: Month as YYYY-MM; defaults to the current month

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: The school's dashboard figures. Pass a `view` to choose which: admin (roll, tickets, announcements), finance (collection), teacher, student, parent, warden or librarian. Omit it and the caller's own role decides. Read-only.

limit.description: Only when the user asks for a number ("top 10", "first 5"); omit it to return everything

limit.description: Only when the user asks for a number ("top 10", "first 5"); omit it to return everything

tools.description: The audit trail: who did what and when, including every action the assistant performed (action names beginning "agent."). roleKey.description: Only actions by holders of this role, e.g. FINANCE

limit.description: Only when the user asks for a number ("top 10", "first 5"); omit it to return everything

cursor.description: From a previous call, to fetch the next page

newTitle.description: The new title, when renaming material named by its current title

fileUrl.description: The path the upload endpoint returned

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

It answers only about the caller — there is no way to name another person — and it says plainly when the school does not record something rather than guessing.
