tools.name: get_school_domain
tools.description: This school's portal address — a platform subdomain or its own custom domain — whether it is verified, whether its certificate works, whether it is live, the DNS records still required, and the domain from the website on the School Admin profile ("Not Provided" when there is none) with whether it has been applied. Read-only, and always about the caller's own school.

tools.name: get_my_day
tools.description: What needs the caller today: their headline figures, tasks due, deadlines and decisions waiting on them. Read-only.

tools.name: list_pending_approvals
tools.description: Approval requests waiting on the caller to decide right now. Read-only: decisions are made on the Approvals page.

tools.name: get_pending_items_for_me
tools.description: Everything waiting on the caller to decide: payments and payment changes awaiting approval, fee plans, leave applications, elective registrations, co-curricular and profile-correction requests, book and transport requests, and the approvals inbox. Only the queues the caller is the decider for, each with how many are waiting and the screen to open. Read-only: every decision is made by the caller on that screen, never by the assistant.

tools.name: list_compliance_deadlines
tools.description: Dated compliance items coming up or overdue: regulatory returns, licence and certificate renewals, policy reviews, mandatory trainings and agreement notice dates. Read-only.

days.description: How many days ahead to look (default 60).

tools.name: list_licences
tools.description: Licences, certificates, recognitions and registrations with their expiry dates and renewal status. Read-only.

tools.name: list_open_correspondence
tools.description: Open letters and circulars from boards, government and other bodies, with their due dates and status. Read-only.

tools.name: list_board_meetings
tools.description: Board, trustee and committee meetings with their dates and status. Read-only.

tools.name: list_fest_plans
tools.description: Events, fests, meetings and visits being planned or held, with dates, status and how ready each one is. Read-only.

tools.name: list_maintenance_work
tools.description: Maintenance work orders that are open, with their place, priority and status. Read-only.

tools.name: get_verification_counts
tools.description: How many background verifications are in progress, awaiting the principal, not cleared, expired or due for re-check. Counts only, no person or finding. Read-only.

tools.name: list_purchase_requests
tools.description: Purchase requests with their amount and stage. The caller sees their own, or the whole school's if they manage purchasing. Read-only.

tools.name: get_budget_position
tools.description: Each budget with what was planned, what is committed to orders and what has been spent. Read-only.

tools.name: list_payroll_runs
tools.description: Payroll runs by month with their status, headcount and totals. Totals only: nobody's individual pay or bank details. Read-only.

tools.name: get_marketing_funnel
tools.description: The admissions funnel in totals: enquiries by stage and by source, conversion and response time. No enquiry details. Read-only.

tools.name: get_organisation_structure
tools.description: The organisation in numbers: departments, positions sanctioned and filled, vacancies and staff not yet placed. Read-only.

tools.name: list_newsroom_posts
tools.description: Recent newsroom stories, achievements and event posts the caller may see. Read-only.

tools.name: list_digital_lectures
tools.description: Upcoming digital lectures and online meetings the caller hosts or is invited to, with their time and host. The join link is not included: a class is joined from its page. Read-only.

tools.name: get_syllabus_progress
tools.description: Syllabus progress by subject and class: the module being taught now, how much is covered, and whether it is on track, behind or has no recent update. A teacher sees their own subjects, a student or parent their class, the principal the whole school. Read-only.

tools.name: get_campus_status
tools.description: The campus right now: rooms in use and free by the timetable and bookings, spaces out of use, and events today. Scheduled use, not live tracking. Read-only.

tools.name: list_ptm_rounds
tools.description: Parent–teacher meeting (PTM) rounds the caller can see: their dates, mode, whether booking is open and until when. A family sees the rounds for their children's classes, a teacher the rounds for their classes. Read-only.

tools.name: get_ptm_slots
tools.description: For a parent: each of their children in a PTM round, each of that child's teachers, the free meeting slots with each, and what is already booked. Read-only; book with reserve_ptm_slot.

round.description: The PTM round title; default the round open for booking

tools.name: reserve_ptm_slot
tools.description: Book parent–teacher meeting slots for the caller's own children: one or several (a child with several teachers, or several children). Each booking names the child, the teacher and the time; the earliest free slot is taken when no time is given. Shown in full before anything is booked; needs confirmation.

studentName.description: The child's name; omit when you have one child

teacherName.description: The teacher's name, their subject ("maths teacher"), "class teacher" or "principal". Default: the class teacher

time.description: Start time, e.g. 16:20 or 4:20 pm. Default: the earliest free slot

date.description: The day, when the PTM runs over several days

mode.description: Only for slots offered both ways

studentName.description: The child's name; omit when you have one child

teacherName.description: The teacher's name, their subject ("maths teacher"), "class teacher" or "principal". Default: the class teacher

time.description: Start time, e.g. 16:20 or 4:20 pm. Default: the earliest free slot

date.description: The day, when the PTM runs over several days

mode.description: Only for slots offered both ways

tools.name: list_my_ptm_bookings
tools.description: The caller's upcoming PTM meetings: for a parent, their bookings for each child; for a teacher, the families booked with them. Read-only.

tools.name: reschedule_ptm_booking
tools.description: Move one of the caller's own PTM bookings to another free slot with the same teacher. Changes close a few hours before the meeting. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: cancel_ptm_booking
tools.description: Cancel one of the caller's own PTM bookings; the slot is offered to the waiting list. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: add_ptm_availability
tools.description: For a teacher: open their own PTM meeting slots between two times on a PTM day; slots are cut at the round's slot length. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: list_review_calls
tools.description: Parent review calls the caller works on or oversees: the pupil, the reason, priority, status, when the call is scheduled, the next follow-up and open actions. Private call notes are not included; read them on the Review calls page. Read-only.

mine.description: Only the calls assigned to the caller

tools.name: open_review_call
tools.description: Open a parent review call about a pupil the caller teaches (attendance, academics, behaviour support, fees, wellbeing or other), assigned to the caller. A safeguarding concern never goes here: it is reported through the safeguarding route. Needs confirmation.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: log_review_call_attempt
tools.description: Log an attempt to reach the family on a review call: the channel and whether they were reached, with a short note. Needs confirmation.

caseRef.description: The review call reference, e.g. RVC-0003

studentName.description: The pupil the call is about

tools.name: add_review_call_note
tools.description: Add a private note to a review call (context, discussion, the parent's view, an agreement). A safeguarding concern is never written here. Needs confirmation.

caseRef.description: The review call reference, e.g. RVC-0003

studentName.description: The pupil the call is about

tools.name: update_review_call_schedule
tools.description: Schedule a review call with the family: the day, the time and the channel. Needs confirmation.

caseRef.description: The review call reference, e.g. RVC-0003

studentName.description: The pupil the call is about

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: The caller's parent–teacher conversations about a child, newest first, with how many messages are unread. unreadOnly lists just the ones with unread messages. Read-only.

tools.name: read_conversation
tools.description: The messages of one of the caller's conversations, found by the other person's name or the child. Reading it marks the messages as read, as opening it on the screen does.

tools.name: send_conversation_message
tools.description: Send a message about a child. A parent writes to their child's class teacher (the default), a subject teacher or the principal; a teacher writes to a guardian of a pupil they teach. It goes into the open conversation between the two, or starts one. Phone numbers typed into it are removed. Needs confirmation.

toName.description: Who it is for: a teacher's name, their subject, "class teacher" or "principal"; for a teacher, the guardian's name

tools.name: get_my_term_report_cards
tools.description: The caller's own (a student) or their child's (a parent) published term report cards: overall percentage and grade, the result line, each subject's grade, attendance, co-scholastic grades and the class teacher's remarks. Only published cards; the latest version of each. Read-only.

tools.name: list_term_report_cards
tools.description: For staff: the term report cards of the classes the caller prepares, with each card's stage (draft, class-teacher approved, principal approved, published) and whether marks and remarks are complete. Read-only.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

tools.name: get_term_report_remark_draft
tools.description: A suggested class-teacher remark for one pupil's term report card, drafted from the card's subject grades and attendance (an AI draft, or a template when no AI is configured). Nothing is saved: read it, edit it, then save it with save_term_report_remarks.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: save_term_report_remarks
tools.description: Write the class teacher's remarks on one pupil's term report card (the class teacher or the principal). An approved card goes back to draft for re-approval. Approving and publishing stay on the Report cards page. Needs confirmation.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

tools.name: list_clubs
tools.description: The clubs, sports teams and activities the school runs: category, activity, who it is for, when it meets, seats and whether it is taking requests to join. Read-only.

tools.name: get_my_club_memberships
tools.description: A student's own, or a parent's children's, club requests and memberships: status (waiting for consent, waiting for approval, waiting list, member), and whether a parent's consent is still needed. Read-only.

tools.name: join_club
tools.description: Ask to join a club: a student for themselves, a parent for their child. A request from a minor waits for a parent's consent; the teacher in charge then approves. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: consent_to_club_join
tools.description: For a parent: give (or refuse) consent for their own child's request to join a club. Only the child's parent can do this, and only for a request waiting for consent. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: list_club_sessions
tools.description: Club sessions in a date range (default the next two weeks): for a family, the clubs their children belong to; for a teacher, the clubs they run; for school-wide staff, every club. Read-only.

tools.name: mark_club_attendance
tools.description: For the teacher in charge of a club: take the register for a session (default today's). Everyone on the register is marked present except the members named as absent or excused. Needs confirmation.

absent.description: Names of members who were absent

tools.name: get_showcase
tools.description: The school's published achievement and top-ranker showcase: each edition and its entries. Only published entries of children whose media consent allows it. Read-only.

tools.name: draft_showcase_entry
tools.description: For showcase publishers: draft an achievement entry for a student in a showcase edition (default the latest one still being prepared). It stays a draft: someone else reviews it, and consent is checked again when the edition is published on the Showcase page. Needs confirmation.

studentId.description: Preferred when known, e.g. from search_students

studentName.description: Full or partial name; an ambiguous match is refused, never guessed

title.description: e.g. "Gold, district chess championship"

tools.name: search_alumni
tools.description: Search the alumni directory by name, batch year or kind (former students or staff). Only people who chose to be listed appear; profession, city and links only where each person agreed to share them. Read-only.

tools.name: list_alumni_events
tools.description: Alumni reunions and events the caller is invited to (all of them for alumni managers): date, venue, status and the caller's own reply. Read-only.

tools.name: rsvp_alumni_event
tools.description: For an alumnus: reply yes, no or maybe to an alumni event they are invited to. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: list_social_posts
tools.description: Posts drafted for the school's social media accounts and what happened on each network (queued, simulated — not posted, failed). Staff only. Read-only.

tools.name: draft_social_post
tools.description: For staff who publish: draft a post for the school's social accounts on the chosen networks (Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, YouTube). Every child in it must be tagged (by admission number) and have public media consent, or the post must say no child can be identified. Drafting sends nothing. Needs confirmation.

noIdentifiableStudents.description: True when no child can be identified in the post

tools.name: send_social_post
tools.description: Send a drafted social post to its networks, at the explicit request of a staff member who publishes. Consent of every tagged child is checked again first. Without provider credentials the outcome is recorded as SIMULATED — not posted; nothing claims to have been posted. Confirmed on the website only.

search.description: Words from the post; default the latest unsent draft

tools.name: get_my_digest
tools.description: The caller's daily digest: headlines from news feeds the school approved, matched to the interests they chose. Headlines and summaries are text from outside sites, quoted as they are. Read-only.

tools.name: update_my_digest_interests
tools.description: Change the topics of the caller's own daily digest (science, technology, sports, careers, education policy, arts, environment, mathematics) and whether it is also emailed. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: get_eco_points
tools.description: The eco-points board: verified points of each class, house and club team, the school total and recent verified activities. Team totals only, no individual pupils. Read-only.

tools.name: list_eco_activities
tools.description: Eco activities logged by the teams the caller works with (every team at school-wide scope), with status: submitted (waiting for verification), verified or rejected. Staff only. Read-only.

tools.name: log_eco_activity
tools.description: Log an eco activity for a class, house or club team the caller leads or teaches (a clean-up, planting drive, awareness session). It earns points only once someone else verifies it. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: verify_eco_activity
tools.description: For a verifier, at their explicit request: verify (award points) or reject an eco activity someone else logged. The person who logged it can never verify it; verifying needs evidence on file or the verifier's statement that they saw it. Confirmed on the website only.

evidenceSeen.description: The verifier saw the activity in person

tools.name: log_waste
tools.description: Record waste the school generated or handed over: the stream (wet, dry, e-waste, sanitary, hazardous lab), the weight in kg, the day and where it went. E-waste, sanitary and hazardous waste handed to a vendor needs the vendor and their receipt number. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: log_meter_reading
tools.description: Record a month's water, electricity, rainwater-harvested or solar-generated figure: the quantity, or the opening and closing meter readings. Recording the same month again corrects it. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: log_plant_check
tools.description: Record a survival check on a tree or plant (alive, needs care, dead, replaced). A check needs a photo already uploaded to EduOS, given as its link; there is no photo upload in a chat. Needs confirmation.

photoUrl.description: Link to a photo already uploaded to EduOS (/uploads/...) or an https:// link

tools.name: list_online_applications
tools.description: Applications received through the online admission form, newest first: the reference, child, class applied for, guardian, the documents attached (names only) and the stage of the enquiry. Move an enquiry along with update_admission_lead. Read-only.

tools.name: find_library_copy
tools.description: Find a physical library copy by its accession number (what is on its barcode label): the book, shelf, status and, when it is out, who has it and when it is due. Or list the copies of a book by its title. Read-only.

tools.name: lend_copy_by_accession
tools.description: Issue a physical copy by its accession number to a student by their admission number, as scanning at the desk does. Due in 14 days unless a date is given. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: checkin_copy_by_accession
tools.description: Take back a physical copy by its accession number, as scanning it at the desk does; any late fine is calculated by the library. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: get_ai_draft
tools.description: Draft a letter, a circular, meeting minutes from notes, a lesson-plan outline or a report-card remark, for the caller to read and edit. Contact numbers and any health or safeguarding detail are removed before drafting. Nothing is sent, published or saved.

tools.name: list_certificate_types
tools.description: The certificates and documents a student or parent can request from the school office (bonafide, transfer, character certificate and so on), with what each needs. Read-only.

tools.name: get_my_certificate_requests
tools.description: A student's own, or a parent's children's, certificate requests and where each stands (pending, in review, approved, issued, rejected, cancelled). Read-only.

tools.name: request_certificate
tools.description: For a student or parent: ask the school office for a certificate (bonafide, transfer, character certificate ...) with the purpose it is for. The office reviews and issues it. Needs confirmation.

studentName.description: For a parent with several children

tools.name: cancel_certificate_request
tools.description: Cancel one of the caller's own certificate requests that the office has not started on yet. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: update_assignment
tools.description: Change homework the caller set: its title, instructions, chapter or due date (to extend a deadline, say). The class sees the change. Needs confirmation.

homework.description: The title of the homework to change

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

title.description: The new title

tools.name: delete_assignment
tools.description: Withdraw homework the caller set: it leaves every list; work already submitted is kept. Needs confirmation.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

tools.name: list_quizzes
tools.description: Quizzes: for a student, the ones open to them with their own attempt and score; for a teacher, the quizzes they set with how many have attempted. Taking a quiz happens on the Quizzes page. Read-only.

tools.name: get_my_quiz_results
tools.description: A student's own submitted quiz attempts: score, right and wrong answers, subject and when. Read-only.

tools.name: log_syllabus_progress
tools.description: For the teacher of a subject: record what was taught in a lesson — the topics covered in the current module (or a named one), a note and any homework given. Updates the class's syllabus progress. Needs confirmation.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

module.description: Default the module being taught now

tools.name: schedule_online_class
tools.description: Schedule an online class (or a doubt session) for a class the caller teaches, on a day and time; the class is told and a meeting room is made. Weekly repeats are possible. Needs confirmation.

className.description: The class as a person names it, e.g. "Class 5 A", "Class 5-A" or "5-A"

repeatWeekly.description: How many weeks in a row (default 1)

tools.name: cancel_online_class
tools.description: Cancel an online class the caller hosts that has not finished; everyone invited is told the reason. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: report_repair
tools.description: Report something that needs repair or attention (a broken fan, a leaking tap, a projector not working): what, where, the kind of work and how urgent. It becomes a work order for the facilities team. Needs confirmation.

place.description: The room or building, as listed on the campus

tools.name: list_my_maintenance_reports
tools.description: The repairs the caller has reported and where each stands (facilities managers see every work order). Read-only.

tools.name: request_facility_reservation
tools.description: Ask to book a room, hall, lab or ground for a time slot (a meeting, a rehearsal). A clash with another booking is refused; the facilities manager confirms the request. Needs confirmation.

title.description: What it is for

tools.name: create_purchase_request
tools.description: Draft a purchase request: a title, the items with quantity and estimated unit price in rupees, and why. It is saved as a draft; adding quotes, submitting it for approval and every approval happen on the Purchasing page. Needs confirmation.

estUnitPrice.description: Estimated price of one unit, in rupees

tools.name: list_due_items
tools.description: Due items and reminders: bills to pay, renewals, service visits, inspections, follow-ups and anything else with a due date. The caller sees their own (or, with school-wide access, everybody's). Filter by open, overdue or done, by department, or by how many days ahead. Read-only.

dueWithinDays.description: Only items due within this many days, e.g. 7 for "this week"

limit.description: Only when the user asks for a number ("top 10", "first 5"); omit it to return everything

tools.name: get_due_items_summary
tools.description: How much is due, in totals: open, overdue, due this week and this month, critical and unassigned items, by department, with the expected cost of the next 90 days. Read-only.

tools.name: create_due_item
tools.description: Add a due item (a reminder with an owner and a due date), e.g. "remind me to renew the fire NOC by 30 November". Owned by the caller; someone who manages every task may give it to a named colleague. Needs confirmation.

repeat.description: Repeats every week, month or year

ownerName.description: A colleague to own it (school-wide task managers only)

tools.name: snooze_due_item
tools.description: Put an open task off until a later date, with the reason (e.g. "snooze the AMC visit to Friday because the vendor is on leave"). A critical task can be put off by one day at most, others by 30 days. Needs confirmation.

title.description: The task named in words, e.g. "AMC visit" — an ambiguous match is asked about

tools.name: complete_due_item
tools.description: Mark an open task done, with a note of what was done (for a task that needs evidence the note describes it; files are attached on the Tasks screen). A repeating task creates its next one. Needs confirmation.

title.description: The task named in words, e.g. "AMC visit" — an ambiguous match is asked about

note.description: What was done, e.g. "Paid by NEFT, UTR 1234"

tools.name: reassign_due_item
tools.description: Give an open task to a named colleague. For those who manage every task. Needs confirmation.

title.description: The task named in words, e.g. "AMC visit" — an ambiguous match is asked about

tools.name: cancel_due_item
tools.description: Cancel an open task that is no longer needed, with the reason. Needs confirmation.

title.description: The task named in words, e.g. "AMC visit" — an ambiguous match is asked about

tools.name: list_bills
tools.description: Recurring bills (electricity, water, internet, AMC, rent ...) with amount, outstanding, due date and status. Filter: open, overdue, payments awaiting a bank check, paid; and "due within N days" (e.g. 7 for "what bills are due this week"). Read-only.

limit.description: Only when the user asks for a number ("top 10", "first 5"); omit it to return everything

tools.name: list_service_visits
tools.description: AMC and service-contract visits: scheduled (and overdue) by default, or done, missed or cancelled. Read-only.

tools.name: list_renewals
tools.description: Everything up for renewal in one list: licences and certificates, agreements and their notice dates, warranties, service contracts and AMCs, lab calibrations and software. With when a decision is needed, the cost where known, the owner and what happens if nothing is done. Read-only.

tools.name: get_bill_review_queue
tools.description: Bills flagged for a person to check: an amount well above usual, a possible duplicate, a consumption jump, a bill past due, a payment with no evidence or not yet confirmed with the bank, an invoice that does not match its order. Each flag states its rule and numbers; flags are prompts, not findings. Read-only.

tools.name: get_bill_costs
tools.description: What the school spends on recurring bills, by category, for a period, compared with the same period last year; plus what is outstanding now. Read-only.

tools.name: record_bill
tools.description: Record a bill that has arrived against a service account (e.g. "the electricity bill for October is ₹48,200, due 25 October"). Its reminder joins the due-items queue. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: record_bill_payment
tools.description: Record a payment made against a bill (amount, mode, reference). It does NOT settle the bill: a different person confirms it against the bank statement. Money, so it is confirmed on the website. Needs confirmation.

account.description: The service named in words, e.g. "electricity" or "lift AMC"

reference.description: UTR, cheque number or transaction id

tools.name: verify_bill_payment
tools.description: The bank check of a recorded bill payment: CONFIRM it with the bank reference (UTR / statement line), or REJECT it with a reason. Only when the checker says so in their own words; a person can never check a payment they recorded themselves. Confirmed on the website.

account.description: The service named in words, e.g. "electricity" or "lift AMC"

tools.name: change_bill_status
tools.description: Dispute a bill, resolve a dispute (optionally with the revised amount), or cancel a wrongly recorded bill — always with a reason; nothing is deleted. Needs confirmation.

account.description: The service named in words, e.g. "electricity" or "lift AMC"

tools.name: schedule_service_visit
tools.description: Schedule an AMC or service visit for a service account on a date. Its reminder joins the due-items queue. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: complete_service_visit
tools.description: Close a scheduled AMC/service visit: DONE (needs the service report — give a link to it, or attach the file on the Bills screen), MISSED or CANCELLED (with the reason). The next visit is scheduled from it. Needs confirmation.

reportLink.description: An https link to the service report or photos

tools.name: note_bill_flag
tools.description: Record what was found on a flagged bill in the review queue: EXPLAINED (with the explanation), DISMISSED (with why) or ESCALATED. Name the flag by its words, e.g. "the duplicate water bill". Needs confirmation.

tools.name: get_labs_overview
tools.description: Each laboratory the caller may see, in figures: items, low stock, expired and expiring batches, quarantined stock, instruments out of service or overdue for calibration, computers in repair, practicals this week and open incidents. Read-only.

tools.name: list_lab_stock
tools.description: Lab stock: what is on hand, what is low, and which batches have expired or expire soon (e.g. "which chemicals expire this month" = show expiring, withinDays 30). Optionally one lab or one item. Read-only.

withinDays.description: For show=expiring: how many days ahead (default 30); expired batches are always included

limit.description: Only when the user asks for a number ("top 10", "first 5"); omit it to return everything

tools.name: list_lab_equipment
tools.description: Lab instruments with their calibration due dates, overdue calibrations and those out of service. Read-only.

tools.name: list_practical_sessions
tools.description: Practical sessions: the ones the caller teaches or runs the lab for, from a date (default today) for N days (default 7), with class, lab, time and readiness status. Read-only.

tools.name: list_lab_incidents
tools.description: Lab incidents (spills, breakages, near misses, equipment failures ...) with their lab, kind, severity and status — open ones by default. The people involved are not given here. Read-only.

tools.name: issue_lab_stock
tools.description: Issue lab stock for use (e.g. "issue 2 beakers to 9A practical"). Taken from the batches that expire first; expired or quarantined stock is never issued, and hazardous items go to the supervising teacher. Needs confirmation.

item.description: The item as people call it, e.g. "beaker 250 mL" or "hydrochloric acid"

labName.description: Which lab, when more than one holds it

unit.description: g, kg, mg, mL, L or pcs; default the item's unit

issuedTo.description: Who or what it is for, e.g. "9A practical" or "Mr Iyer"

tools.name: record_lab_stock_use
tools.description: Record lab stock used up (CONSUMED) or broken/spoilt (DAMAGED, with the reason). Disposal needs evidence and is recorded on the Labs screen. Needs confirmation.

item.description: The item as people call it, e.g. "beaker 250 mL" or "hydrochloric acid"

labName.description: Which lab, when more than one holds it

batch.description: The batch code, when it matters which bottle

tools.name: receive_lab_stock
tools.description: Receive new lab stock as a batch (quantity, expiry printed on the container, supplier, lot). A chemical needs its expiry date or "no expiry". Needs confirmation.

item.description: The item as people call it, e.g. "beaker 250 mL" or "hydrochloric acid"

labName.description: Which lab, when more than one holds it

tools.name: record_lab_calibration
tools.description: Record that a lab instrument was calibrated: certificate number, date and validity (default: its calibration interval). Needs confirmation.

tools.name: plan_practical_session
tools.description: Plan a practical in a lab for a class at a date and time (the lab is checked for clashes). Materials are added on the Labs screen. Needs confirmation.

className.description: e.g. "Class 9 A"

tools.name: report_lab_incident
tools.description: Report a lab incident (spill, injury, breakage, fire, exposure, near miss, equipment failure ...). The lab's in-charge is told; a high-severity incident or injury also goes to the principal and administrator. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: draft_lab_reorder
tools.description: Draft a purchase request to reorder a lab item (default: its reorder quantity). Only a DRAFT: it is completed and submitted through Procurement by a person. Needs confirmation.

item.description: The item as people call it, e.g. "beaker 250 mL" or "hydrochloric acid"

labName.description: Which lab, when more than one holds it

tools.name: list_fee_adjustments
tools.description: Fee concessions, credit notes and voids on issued invoices, with the student, amount, reason and where each stands (open ones by default). Read-only.

tools.name: list_concession_schemes
tools.description: The school's fee concession schemes (sibling, staff ward, merit ...) with how each is worked out and who is eligible. Read-only.

tools.name: request_fee_adjustment
tools.description: Request a fee concession (under a scheme), a credit note or a void on an issued invoice, with the reason. It goes to the approvals engine and changes nothing until an approver decides. A credit note or void also needs fees.manage. Money, so it is confirmed on the website.

scheme.description: For a concession: the scheme name or code

amountRupees.description: For a credit note, or a discretionary concession

tools.name: withdraw_fee_adjustment
tools.description: Withdraw a fee concession, credit note or void that is still waiting for approval. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: record_concession_decision
tools.description: Record the approver's own decision on a fee concession, credit note or void waiting at their approval stage: APPROVE, REJECT (with a reason) or RETURN for changes. Only when the approver says so in their own words; never suggested. Nobody decides a request they raised. Confirmed on the website.

studentName.description: Or the student it is for

tools.name: get_gst_summary
tools.description: GST on fee lines for a period, by HSN/SAC and rate (taxable value, CGST, SGST), with untaxed lines and credits on taxed invoices — for the accountant. Not tax advice. The Tally voucher file is downloaded on the Accounts export screen. Read-only.

tools.name: get_my_child_bus
tools.description: Where my child's bus is today: their trip, its status, their stop, the estimated arrival (an estimate), and whether they have boarded, got off or been handed over. Only the caller's own child (or own trips); never other children. Read-only.

tools.name: get_live_bus_status
tools.description: Every bus right now: whether its location is live, stale or offline, when it was last seen, and the trip it is running. For the transport office and the principal. The map is on the Fleet screen. Read-only.

tools.name: list_trips
tools.description: Bus trips on a day (default today): vehicle, status, seats used and free, and how many have boarded, got off or not shown up. A teacher on bus duty sees only their own trips. Read-only.

tools.name: record_trip_boarding
tools.description: Record a student boarding (BOARDED), getting off (ALIGHTED) or not at the stop (NO_SHOW) on a trip the caller runs. A no-show tells the guardians. A wrong vehicle is refused and raised as an alert. Safe handover at a drop is recorded on the Fleet screen. Confirmed on the website.

tripRef.description: When more than one trip is running

tools.name: list_vehicles
tools.description: School vehicles with status, capacity, and papers (permit, insurance, fitness, PUC) expired or expiring within 30 days, plus safety checks and service due. Read-only.

tools.name: log_vehicle_event
tools.description: Log a fuel fill, a service, a breakdown (which takes the vehicle off the road unless told otherwise), an odometer reading or a fire-extinguisher / first-aid check for a vehicle. Needs confirmation.

keepOnRoad.description: For a minor breakdown that does not take the vehicle off the road

tools.name: get_visitors_on_site
tools.description: Visitors and contractors: on site now (default), expected today, or waiting for their host. With host, purpose, check-in time and overstays. Read-only.

tools.name: add_visitor
tools.description: Pre-register a visitor or contractor: name, purpose, host, expected time. A visitor for someone else waits for that host's approval; a contractor needs the work order or check done. Needs confirmation.

hostName.description: The member of staff they are meeting; default the caller

contractorCheckNote.description: For a contractor: the work order or the check done

tools.name: update_visitor
tools.description: Check a visitor in (only after their photo ID has been seen — say so), check them out, or cancel an expected visit. Only the ID's type and last four characters are kept. Needs confirmation.

idVerified.description: For check-in: the photo ID was seen

tools.name: get_emergency_roster
tools.description: Who should be on campus now, for an evacuation or emergency count: students marked present and not released or out on a pass (by class), released today, on out-pass, and visitors checked in. A roster to account for people in person, not a location tracker; the named list is printed from the Gate screen. Read-only.

tools.name: list_my_child_delegates
tools.description: For a parent: the adults authorised to collect their own child (standing and time-limited delegates) and the child's recent gate releases. Read-only.

tools.name: request_pickup_delegation
tools.description: For a parent: let another adult collect their own child for a while (e.g. "let my brother Sunil collect Aarav on Friday"). A one-time code is sent to the parent's phone; the delegation starts once the parent gives that code back. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: confirm_pickup_delegation
tools.description: For a parent: confirm a pending pickup delegation with the one-time code sent to their phone. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: revoke_pickup_delegation
tools.description: For a parent: end a pickup delegation or authorisation they gave for their own child. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: get_my_child_checkpoints
tools.description: ID-card checkpoints on a day (default today). A parent sees their own child's gate and bus scans; school-wide staff see counts by checkpoint and how many were flagged. A scan shows a card was presented there and then, not where someone is now. Read-only.

tools.name: block_id_card
tools.description: Block a student's or staff member's ID card as LOST or REVOKED, so scans of it are refused from now on. A replacement is issued on the Gate screen. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: get_camera_review_count
tools.description: For trained camera reviewers only: how many camera observations are waiting for review. A count and nothing else; the observations themselves are reviewed on the Camera review screen. Read-only.

tools.name: list_my_outpasses
tools.description: The caller's own (a student's) or own children's (a parent's) hostel out-passes and where each stands. Read-only.

tools.name: list_outpasses
tools.description: Hostel out-passes for the warden: waiting for a decision (default), approved, out now, overdue back, or all. Read-only.

tools.name: request_outpass
tools.description: Request a hostel out-pass (e.g. "request an out-pass for my son on Saturday 10 am to Sunday 6 pm to go home"). A parent's request goes straight to the warden; a student's first goes to their guardian. Needs confirmation.

childName.description: A parent's child; a student requests for themselves

tools.name: cancel_outpass
tools.description: Cancel an own (or own child's) out-pass that has not been used yet. Needs confirmation.

tools.name: record_outpass_consent
tools.description: For a parent: record their own consent (APPROVED) or refusal (REJECTED) for an out-pass their child asked for. Only when the parent says so themselves. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: record_outpass_decision
tools.description: For the warden: record their own decision on an out-pass waiting for them — APPROVED, or REJECTED with the reason. Only when the warden says so in their own words; never suggested. The guardians are told. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: record_outpass_gate
tools.description: Record a resident leaving (EXIT, on an approved out-pass) or coming back (RETURN) at the gate by hand; a late return alerts the wardens. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: get_staff_leave_balance
tools.description: Leave balance for this leave year (April–March): entitled, carried forward, used, pending and available per leave type. The caller's own by default; HR and the principal may name a colleague. Read-only.

tools.name: list_staff_leave
tools.description: Staff leave applications: the caller's own, or — for HR and the principal — everyone's (pending by default for them), optionally on a date or for one colleague. Read-only.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, who is on leave that day

tools.name: apply_staff_leave
tools.description: Apply for the caller's own staff leave (e.g. "apply for casual leave on Monday because of a family function"): type, dates (or a half day), reason. The draft shows the working days it counts and the balance left. HR and the principal are told. Needs confirmation.

type.description: CL casual, SL sick, EL earned, ML maternity, PL paternity, DL duty, LWP without pay

tools.name: cancel_staff_leave
tools.description: Withdraw the caller's own pending leave, or cancel an approved leave that has not started (its balance is restored and cover for the days ahead is cancelled). Needs confirmation.

tools.name: record_staff_leave_decision
tools.description: For HR and the principal: record their own decision on a colleague's pending leave — APPROVE (the balance is deducted) or REJECT with the reason. Only when the approver says so in their own words; never suggested. Nobody decides their own leave. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: get_cover_arrangements
tools.description: Substitute cover on a day (default today): who is covering which class and period in place of whom (e.g. "who is covering 7B period 3"), or with mine=true the covers the caller is taking. Read-only.

tools.name: get_cover_needs
tools.description: For the cover coordinator: who is away on a day (default today) — on approved leave or marked absent — and which of their periods still need cover. Absence reasons are not given. Read-only.

tools.name: suggest_cover_teachers
tools.description: For the cover coordinator: the best substitutes for one class and period on a day — free then, in school, within the cover limits; same subject and same class first — and who cannot and why. Read-only; nobody is assigned.

tools.name: assign_cover
tools.description: For the cover coordinator: confirm a named teacher as the substitute for one class and period (e.g. "assign Ms Rao to cover 8C period 2"). Refused when they are busy then; going over the cover limit needs a reason. The absent teacher, the substitute and the class are told. Confirmed on the website.

overrideReason.description: Only to go over the cover limit

tools.name: cancel_cover
tools.description: For the cover coordinator: cancel a confirmed cover for a class and period, with the reason. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: mark_staff_absent
tools.description: For the cover coordinator: mark a colleague absent for a day (an unplanned absence) so their lessons show as needing cover. Loss of pay is a payroll input and is set on the Cover screen, not here. Confirmed on the website.

tools.name: get_analytics_overview
tools.description: The analytics workspace in words: the headline figures (or one department's) for a period — this month, quarter, year, academic or financial year — with the change against the previous period or last year, and how complete each figure is. Within the caller's own departments or classes. The CSV is downloaded on the Analytics screen. Read-only.

department.description: e.g. finance, academics, admissions, people, facilities, procurement; default all (headlines)

tools.name: list_quarterly_reports
tools.description: The quarterly decision reports addressed to the caller: each quarter and version, its status and when it was generated. Read-only.

tools.name: get_quarterly_report
tools.description: One quarterly report (the latest by default, or e.g. "FY2026-27-Q2"): the summary figures with their change on the prior quarter and last year, limited to the sections the caller receives. The PDF is downloaded on the Reports screen. Read-only.

tools.name: regenerate_quarterly_report
tools.description: Generate a new version of a quarterly report (the previous quarter by default) from the live records, with the reason. Earlier versions stay as they were. It is NOT sent: distribution to the recipients is done on the Reports screen. Needs confirmation.

compatibilityAliases.purpose: Redeems a proposal the pre-MCP agent stored under the old name. No new proposal is ever stored under it.
compatibilityAliases.removableWhen: No AgentAction row with tool "apply_leave" is PENDING or EXECUTING, and at least 10 minutes have passed since the first MCP deployment.

deprecated.name: record_fee_payment
deprecated.status: Not in the MCP catalog and not reachable from either channel. Recording a payment is a decision made on the Payments screen; the assistant has no tool for it. Kept only because agent.bulkAuthorization.test.js exercises its permission metadata; safe to delete together with those assertions.

blocked.reason: By design. Every tool calls an existing EduOS service; no tool accepts a query, collection, model or update document (enforced by tests/mcp.architecture.test.js).
By design. No tool accepts a URL to call or a command to run.
By design. update_student, update_ticket, update_book and update_hostel_room apply explicit field allow-lists; student.service.update() enforces its own for every caller.
Charging a family from a chat message is not something confirm-before-commit makes safe enough. Families pay through the payment link; staff record payments with record_payment.

blocked.capability: bulk WhatsApp / email to all parents
blocked.reason: announcement.service.dispatch() writes a log line for the email and WhatsApp channels and sends nothing, and Meta requires approved templates for business-initiated messages. A tool would report a delivery that never happened. One-to-one send_whatsapp_message exists.
No service writes Account.phoneE164 after creation; phone lives on the Account, not the Student. Would need new business logic.
Only OTP email exists, and EMAIL_PROVIDER=console logs rather than sends.
No generator exists; the PDF generators that do exist stream to an HTTP response and return nothing reusable.
No service; updateEnrollmentStatus() only sets one enrolment's status (exposed as update_enrollment_status).
No report service; MCP returns the data (get_fee_statistics, get_pending_fees), not a file.
Only soft delete (archive_student) and irreversible anonymisation (anonymise_student) exist, both confirmed. Correct as-is.
The permission exists in the catalog but no route or service implements it.
